“PART 8A—SUSPENSION OF FARM HOUSEHOLD SUPPORT IF DROUGHT RELIEF PAYMENT IS PAYABLE

p.b: Farm household support ceases to be payable if drought relief payment is payable

content.p: “49A. Farm household support ceases, and is taken to have ceased, to be payable to a person at the beginning of a period if the person is receiving, or has received, drought relief payment in respect of that period.

p.b: Suspension of farm household support where drought relief payment is payable—Division 2 of Part 6 not applicable

content.p: “49B.(1) This section applies to a person if:

(a) at a particular time (the ‘original FHS cessation time’), farm household support ceases, or ceased, to be payable to the person because drought relief payment becomes, or became, payable to the person; and
(b) at a later time (the ‘DRP cessation time’), drought relief payment ceases to be payable to the person; and
(c) immediately before the original FHS cessation time, the person was not qualified for farm household support under Division 2 of Part 6.

p.i: Deemed claim for farm household support

content.p: “(2) The person is taken to have made a proper claim (the ‘new FHS claim’) for farm household support under Part 3 immediately after the DRP cessation time.

“(3) If the Secretary determines under section 19 that the new FHS claim is to be granted, a declaration, direction or notice in force in relation to the person under section 23, 32 or 41 immediately before the original FHS cessation time has effect, in relation to farm household support payable as a result of the new FHS claim, as if the declaration, direction or notice, as the case requires, had been given immediately after the determination takes effect.
“(4) For the purposes of subsection 50(1), the time at which farm household support ceased to be payable to the person as mentioned in subsection (1) of this section is taken to be:
SCHEDULE—continued
(a) if the new FHS claim is granted—when farm household support payable to the person as a result of the new FHS claim ceases to be payable; or
(b) in any other case—the DRP cessation time;
instead of the original FHS cessation time.
“(5) For the purposes of the application of sections 5 and 52 to the person:
(a) the start of the person’s grant period is to be worked out as if farm household support were payable to the person throughout the period (the ‘interim period’):
(i) beginning at the original FHS cessation time; and
(ii) ending at the DRP cessation time; and
(b) a period of 9 months or 2 years referred to in either of those sections is to be increased by one day for each whole day in the interim period.

p.b: Suspension of farm household support where drought relief payment is payable—Division 2 of Part 6 applicable

content.p: “49C.(1) This section applies to a person if:

(a) at a particular time (the ‘original FHS cessation time’), farm household support ceases, or ceased, to be payable to the person because drought relief payment becomes, or became, payable to the person; and
(b) at a later time (the ‘DRP cessation time’), drought relief payment ceases to be payable to the person; and
(c) immediately before the original FHS cessation time, the person was qualified for farm household support under Division 2 of Part 6.

p.i: Resumption of entitlement to farm household support

content.p: “(2) If the person is still qualified for farm household support under Division 2 of Part 6 immediately before the DRP cessation time, the person’s entitlement to farm household support under Division 2 of Part 6 resumes immediately after the DRP cessation time.

“(3) If the person’s entitlement to farm household support resumes as mentioned in subsection (2), a direction or notice in force in relation to the person under section 32 or 41 immediately before the original FHS cessation
SCHEDULE—continued
time has effect, in relation to farm household support payable as a result of the resumption, as if the direction or notice, as the case requires, had been given immediately after the resumption.

“(4) For the purposes of subsection 50(2), the time at which farm household support ceased to be payable to the person as mentioned in subsection (1) of this section is taken to be the time when farm household support payable to the person as a result of the resumption ceases to be payable, instead of the original FHS cessation time.

“(5) For the purposes of the application of sections 5 and 52 to the person, a period of 9 months or 2 years referred to in either of those sections is to be increased by one day for each whole day in the period:
(a) beginning at the original FHS cessation time; and
(b) ending at the DRP cessation time.

p.i: Continuity of the person’s status as a former RAS (Part C) beneficiary

(a) beginning at the original FHS cessation time; and
(b) ending at the DRP cessation time.”.
